# TTM Technologies, Inc. to Conduct Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call on October 22, 2026


October 14, 2026 7:17am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4859ae7ca12e8f643bb036b7c483f05e/ttm/news/2026-10-14_TTM_Technologies_Inc_to_Conduct_Third_Quarter_418.pdf)


SANTA ANA, Calif., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TTM Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:TTMI) will hold a conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time/ 5:30 a.m. Pacific Time to discuss its third quarter 2026 performance, hosted by President & CEO, Edwin Roks, and Executive Vice President & CFO, Dan Boehle.


Access to the conference call will be available by clicking on the registration link[TTM Technologies, Inc. Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=XGOTdGygT6gUXisbUToOz1duztITqyR_Q65s_5VmfXLEDfxgLN1GLud--JscPx6aA7HJ-ExbNq_M_Tl4ud4jCRPXzVJtdtoiQjRDL_5nJpOaFeyxSQBWQ76Q5JC-igBGWQ-ButVca2PuPNwf8YOilt3jzeZ_RYLXNGsGPmp08jFpNb4E9qBqIJk1VsMBLpUngGDHms-48dgFx-YQDiKqGh4jieLVYsx4X-s98Fsqrro=) . Registering participants will receive dial in information and a unique PIN to join the call. Participants can register at any time up to the start of the conference call. The conference call will also be simulcast on the company’s website for those who would like to view the live webcast, and this can be accessed by clicking on the link[TTM Technologies Third Quarter 2026 Webcast](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=XGOTdGygT6gUXisbUToOz5v5Kb8Yle-QBrGH3383fVltT8_FfMWGo2Aq-_uBcVD2h4EO6LS6A3mErqODuOkvM6dLqY59PgseMsN1BqvAK-SS4x0uXgBZRB6Bfhhhx3jcgKCexj_WkxXVafoyMvSuPZFY0xmwSs2a1jdf64rotEo=) . The webcast will remain accessible for one week following the live event.


TTM Technologies, Inc. will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, October 22, 2026.


**About TTM Technologies** TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced interconnect products, including PCBs and substrates. TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market. Additional information can be found at[www.ttm.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PThD1aeASHT4ZSaIz2qr5RqaPbpFSHy-eEoTgkH38Ta9OHqKgHxsif11JGNqaLCgu_C8hpJehi-DKGD5OHba7Q==) .
